cues.text: LangGraph Studio shows all of this.

Point it at the local server, and
every example appears as a graph.

Choose a ready-made
case from the dropdown,

press Submit, and the graph
follows each step as it runs.

Then click any step to
inspect exactly what it read

and wrote, including
what the model returned.

Or go back to any checkpoint,
re-run from there,

and fork the thread to
take a different turn.
